title: Gatekeeper verdict
description: The versioned JSON a non-.NET caller receives from 'agenteval gatekeeper inspect'. One object per inspect; one per line (JSONL) for --input batch. Frozen contract (mirrors the AgentTrace frozen-contract discipline).

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only on a breaking field change.

gate.description: The gate id as invoked, e.g. 'judge:exfiltration-intent', 'keyword-injection', 'tool:referential-integrity'.

action.description: Full shipped verdict-action surface. An unmapped/unknown action fails closed to 'Block' + inconclusive:true.

axis.description: Recovered from 'policy' when it matches 'judge:<axis>', else null (a panel's policy is 'judge-panel' → axis null).

reason.description: Human-readable; generic (never the secret) for the two redacted judge axes by rubric design.

matches.description: Evidence spans. ALWAYS null for 'exfiltration-intent' and 'system-prompt-extraction' (the phrase may be the secret), including via a panel.

redactedText.description: A masked, SAFE replacement (e.g. rendered-exfil's neutralized output). null for the two redact judge axes and when the gate set none.

inlineReady.description: Judge gates only. From the calibration certificate. null (N/A) for deterministic gates.

inconclusive.description: true when the outcome is a fail-closed abstention (judge inconclusive, or the CLI could not reconstruct required inputs).

warning.description: e.g. 'uncalibrated — advisory only', 'fail-closed: required history missing'.

confidence.description: Always null in v1 (collapsed at the IChatGate boundary; a schema-consistency choice).

certificate.description: Provenance when a calibration certificate governed inlineReady: one object for a single-axis judge, an array (one per child) for a panel, null for deterministic gates and advisory paths.

newArguments.description: Reserved for Mutate tool verdicts; null in v1.
